'''Ruslan Leonidovich Smelyansky''' ({{langx|ru|Руслан Леонидович Смелянский}}; born 12 November 1950) is a [[Russian mathematician]], [[Doctor of Science|Dr. Sc.]], [[Professor (highest academic rank)|Professor]], a professor at the [[MSU CMC|Faculty of Computer Science at the Moscow State University]], [[Corresponding Member]] of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>[http://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/5030 Annals of the Moscow University]{{in lang|ru}}</ref>

He defended the thesis «Analysis of the performance of multiprocessor systems based on the invariant behavior of programs» for the degree of [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] (1990).<ref>[http://cs.msu.ru/persons/smeliansky-r-l MSU CMC]{{in lang|ru}}</ref> He is the author of six books.<ref>[https://istina.msu.ru/profile/Smel/ Scientific works of Ruslan Smelyansky]</ref><ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=27558&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Ruslan Smelyansky]{{in lang|en}}</ref>
